name: family-travel-editor
description: AI-assisted travel video editing: organize footage, plan family films, draft voiceover and apply timecoded feedback with your preferred editor.

interface.longDescription: An independent agent skill for travel videos and family films. Organize footage, reconstruct context, plan scenes, draft voiceover and apply timecoded feedback. The workflow is editor-independent; bundled helpers provide video-only FFmpeg previews and experimental Resolve XML interchange. Other editors need manual assembly or a separate adapter. Requires a local agent; optional services are configured separately.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan one scene from my travel footage using my preferred editor.
